fields.use_description: Machines And Cloud LLC (Machines & Cloud) provides customer-care replies to people who first text +13464853328 about their own use of its AI front desk software, workspace setup or account access. Each reply answers the person's incoming question or provides the requested support link. Plan information is returned only when the person asks about pricing. No recurring, proactive, promotional, missed-call, shop-service or homeowner messages are sent.
fields.message_flow: Customer-initiated conversational SMS is the sole consent path, not keyword enrollment. The public invitation, complete disclosures and example exchange are at https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html#platform-sms. After reading them, the person sends their own account/setup question to +13464853328, for example 'I cannot sign in' or 'Help me set up'. We reply only to that request with secure sign-in or workspace setup guidance; plan details are returned only if the person asks about pricing. HELP, INFO or AYUDA returns support links, not enrollment. We retain the incoming message ID, sender, content and timestamp as evidence of consent for that exchange only. No website form/checkbox, phone call, email, verbal permission, signup, booking, entered phone number or purchased list provides SMS permission. No recurring or proactive messages are sent. Message frequency varies with the questions the person sends. Message and data rates may apply. STOP, ALTO, PARAR and standard stop keywords block replies; one stop confirmation may be sent. START, UNSTOP or EMPEZAR removes a prior block only; it does not subscribe anyone or authorize recurring messages. The opt-in/restart fields below describe this unblocking acknowledgment, not a subscription flow. Terms: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html. Privacy: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/privacy-policy.html#sms.
fields.sample_message_one: Machines & Cloud: sign in securely at https://machinesandcloud.com/desk. Request a fresh email link there. Never text a password or sign-in code. Reply STOP to stop texts.
fields.sample_message_two: Machines & Cloud: continue your workspace setup at https://machinesandcloud.com/onboard using your setup email. Reply STOP to stop texts.
fields.sample_message_three: Machines & Cloud: account help at https://machinesandcloud.com/desk. Setup guidance at https://machinesandcloud.com/onboard. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to stop texts.
fields.sample_message_four: Machines & Cloud: you asked about plan pricing. Current plan details are at https://machinesandcloud.com/#plans. Reply STOP to stop texts.
fields.sample_message_five: Machines & Cloud: this line provides account and setup guidance. For secure account access, visit https://machinesandcloud.com/desk. Reply STOP to stop texts.
